Subject: SI-CM-0008 (SUP-08) — supporting evidence requested for qualification

Hello,

Thank you for your packet for SI-CM-0008, rev A. Please send supporting evidence for the following items, which are currently stated without records:

1. 1.internal_audit — internal audit program: procedure and recent audit records.
2. 1.capa — documented corrective-action (CAPA) process: procedure and sample records.
3. 1.calibration — gauge calibration program covering production gauges: procedure and calibration records.
4. 2.pfmea — current process failure-mode analysis (PFMEA) for this part.
5. 2.control_plan — production control plan covering rail spacing, mounting fastener torque and manifold alignment.
6. 2.spc — SPC in use on the CTQs now: control charts and reaction plan.
7. 3.inspection_method — inspection method for the CTQ tolerances: methods and equipment used.
8. 5.lot_trace — lot or serial traceability to raw material: procedure and a sample trace record.
9. 5.nc_segregation — nonconforming material identification and segregation: procedure and records.
10. 8.flowdown — requirements flowed down to sub-tier suppliers: flowdown document or purchase-order terms.

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts
